# Tokenizer test fixtures

## `scroll-123de70e.md` + `olmoe-scroll-123de70e.llama-8642541b.ids`

Used by `tokenizer::tests::real_gguf_olmoe_scroll_matches_llama_cpp`, which loads
`$ARTIFICER_TEST_MODELS/olmoe-1b-7b-0924-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf` and skips when
`ARTIFICER_TEST_MODELS` is unset/empty or the file is missing (same helper as the other
model-backed tests).

- `scroll-123de70e.md`: a cleaned copy of an earlier project document (a few internal notes reworded; headings,
  tables, lists, code fences, box-drawing art, non-ASCII and whitespace runs unchanged), git blob
  `123de70e1aac7af789d0ad337de734532586993f` (`git hash-object scroll-123de70e.md`
  prints that id), 35351 bytes. Frozen here so the golden ids stay stable.
- `olmoe-scroll-123de70e.llama-8642541b.ids`: the 10956 token ids llama.cpp
  8642541b255bfb5dc39cd351a178be09013a55d6 produces for that text with
  `llama_tokenize(vocab, text, add_special = true, parse_special = false)` after dropping one
  trailing `'\n'` (the text prep `llama-perplexity` uses), on
  `olmoe-1b-7b-0924-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf` (OLMoE-1B-7B-0924-Instruct Q4_K_M; no BOS is added
  for this vocab). One line, space-separated.
  - sha256: `da178f442fe56d30c910a665c5c61b8e2da2270c612c7cdfe4af71b3253176c5`
  - Generated by a dev-only harness (not in this repo) linked against llama.cpp 8642541b
    `build-cpu` libs:
    `nice -n 19 llama_ppl_nll-v2 olmoe-1b-7b-0924-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf scroll-123de70e.md 512 0 OUT 8`
    which tokenizes as above and writes `OUT/tokens_all_llama.txt` (this file).
  - Cross-check: a vocab-only harness (`llama_model_params.vocab_only = true`, same
    `llama_tokenize(..., true, false)` call, one trailing '\n' dropped) gives the same ids:
    `llama_tok olmoe-1b-7b-0924-instruct-q4_k_m.gguf scroll-123de70e.md 1 0 OUT.ids --strip-nl`
    (10956 ids, one per line; identical once joined with spaces).

## `ollama/tinyvicuna-sky.prompt.txt`, `ollama/nemotron-sky.prompt.txt`

Raw prompts used by `tokenizer::tests::real_gguf_matches_ollama_tiny_vicuna` and
`real_gguf_matches_ollama_nemotron` (model-backed; skip when `ARTIFICER_TEST_MODELS` is unset
or the GGUF is missing). The expected ids in those tests are what Ollama 0.40.5 produced for the
same GGUF and raw prompt (BOS prepended). These are the prompts the reference ids were generated
from (moved here unchanged):

- `tinyvicuna-sky.prompt.txt`: 217 bytes, sha256 `0d3816ebc2d49eb9e49929ea3f4a802bcea4902cdf69319e8e5d34f7d75a36c6`
- `nemotron-sky.prompt.txt`: 134 bytes, sha256 `515b30f2e0d12439b3a67329ebc153d6ac38fc2dfa3187b29dc6b2a1b8c577ae`
